description: Provenance of the Bible text shipped in src/data/bible/. Kept as an audit record of where the dataset came from. The per-book chapter and verse counts that used to be listed here are omitted deliberately — src/data/bible/manifest.json is the live, validated record of those.

macedonian.source: The content owner's own Macedonian edition, delivered as three JSON files.

deliveredFiles.note: Old Testament, part 1 (Joshua–Malachi) — 34 books, 742 chapters, 17293 verses
Old Testament, part 2 (Genesis–Deuteronomy) — 5 books, 187 chapters, 5852 verses

notes: The delivery's own book names were long forms (e.g. 'Евангелие според Матеј'). The site uses the shorter approved names in src/features/bible/bible.display-names.ts.

The delivered New Testament encoded сѐ/нѐ with the Latin 'è' (U+00E8) instead of the Cyrillic 'ѐ' (U+0450), which breaks search. This was corrected inside otherwise-Cyrillic words only; no other character was altered.

english.source: World English Bible (WEB) — public domain, no attribution required.
notes: Not a translation of the Macedonian text — an independent public-domain translation.
Verse boundaries were renumbered to the Macedonian scheme in 3 John 1, Acts 14 and Romans 14/16. A numbering change only: no English word was added, removed or altered.

editorialNotes.reason: A short, fixed list of verse numbers that critical-text translations omit (e.g. Matthew 17:21, Mark 7:16, John 5:4, Acts 8:37) would otherwise leave a gap in the numbering. Those verses carry a bracketed note instead.
